summary: The miniature has the right cream-and-gray palette and a plausible theater footprint, but its low generic massing and reduced entry treatment miss the reference building’s most recognizable character.

orientation.summary: SV2 is a located, nearly head-on view of the NE-facing -u facade and shows the long veranda with the principal dark double doors. The labeled render places one dark double-door portal on -u, and the actual inventory confirms that sole door at outward bearing 56° toward Pratt Avenue. No duplicated principal portal is visible; SV4 is an interior view and does not contradict this placement.

issues.problem: The model reads as a low single-story pavilion, while the street views show a taller, more vertical building form; the side elevation in SV1 is especially characteristic.
issues.fix: Increase the wall/eave height and restore the taller side-facade proportions while retaining the caricature scale.

issues.problem: The principal -u entrance lacks the long raised timber veranda, prominent stairs, railings, posts, and sheltered porch depth visible in SV2.
issues.fix: Build out a continuous raised veranda across the entrance facade with posts, railing, steps, and the dark double doors centered among tall flanking windows.

issues.problem: The oversized simple hip roof and recessed roof pocket do not capture the aerial’s articulated intersecting roof silhouette and cross-gable character.
issues.fix: Reshape the roof into clearly legible linked hipped and cross-gabled volumes, emphasizing the entrance gable and avoiding the courtyard-like recess.
